title: On subwavelength guided seismic waves in Matryoshka-type elastic media with ring defects
summary: Seismic surface waves, particularly low-frequency Rayleigh waves, are notoriously destructive and remain difficult to control using conventional engineering methods. Recent advances in elastic metamaterials have opened new avenues for manipulating and guiding seismic waves at subwavelength scales. In this work, we present a rigorous mathematical study of subwavelength resonances and seismic-wave localization in arbitrarily shaped Matryoshka-type elastic metamaterials, which are composed of nested high-contrast resonators made of materials much stiffer than the background medium.
